blocks.text: BAGABAG, Nueva Vizcaya — Bagabag town showcased a giant ‘buko’ (coconut) pie display made up of 480 standard-sized pies during the 23rd Pabbalat Festival and its 285th Founding Anniversary on Tuesday. Bagabag Mayor Benigno Calauad told reporters that the giant display of buko pies, which had a 15-meter diameter, was given free to residents who attended the gathering. Vendors cooked the pies along the buko pie alleys in the town. “We talked with the tourism officer and the buko pie makers to prepare the giant display, and these were consumed quickly,” Calauad said.
